thread.title_full: Trump to Meet with Netanyahu and Zelenskyy Amid Tensions and Strains

author: The Associated Press
title: Trump to Meet with Netanyahu and Zelenskyy Amid Tensions and Strains
text:
• Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is meeting with President Donald Trump on Tuesday.
• The meeting is the first since the two leaders launched a joint war against Iran.
• Netanyahu is staying at Blair House, the U.S. government's guest house across from the White House.
• Security around the White House is tight due to Zelenskyy and Netanyahu visits.
• Only foot traffic is allowed on streets surrounding the complex.
• Vehicular traffic is blocked by city police cars and dump trucks at key intersections.
• Trump is set to meet with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy on Tuesday ahead of Sen. Lindsey Graham's funeral.
• Zelenskyy will visit Trump at the White House before Sen. Graham's funeral.
• Trump and Zelenskyy will meet at 9:30 a.m., followed by Netanyahu at 11 a.m.
• The two leaders plan to discuss the framework agreement the U.S. and Israel signed with Lebanon over the Israel-Hezbollah war.
• The expansion of the Abraham Accords will also be discussed.
• Trump is expected to deliver remarks at Sen. Lindsey Graham's funeral.
• Sen. Lindsey Graham will be eulogized during memorial services across Washington.
• Zelenskyy has listed the goals for his visit, including meetings with President Trump, his team, and those who can support Ukraine's defense.
• Zelenskyy's number one priority is anti-ballistic defense and strategic cooperation with America.
• Netanyahu's meeting with Trump is a chance to smooth out strains in their relationship.
• The meeting comes as both leaders face growing pressures at home.
• Netanyahu is up for reelection and is embattled in part because of his deteriorating relationship with Trump.
• Trump is under pressure to end an unpopular war that has wreaked economic havoc and driven prices higher ahead of midterm elections this November.
• Trump said he and Netanyahu have a "little difference" on Iran, but are "pretty close."
summary: Trump is also set to meet with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy on Tuesday ahead of Sen. Lindsey Graham’s funeral, which will be their second sit-down this month. Security around the White House is tight due to Zelenskyy and Netanyahu visits Only foot traffic is allowed on streets surrounding the complex. Vehicular traffic is blocked by city police cars and dump trucks at key intersections, like Pennsylvania Avenue and 17th St and near Lafayette Park.
